observations: Photo 0 shows a small blue hand-held toy with 5 colored piano-style keys, each printed with a cartoon dog character, and a round badge reading "Bluey" plus an orange carry handle.
Photo 1 shows the back of the same toy: a battery compartment cover printed with 'Basic model: 4Z1018' and 'Batch code: 10008', screw-mounted, confirming it is battery-powered.
No screen, no full keyboard layout, no sustain pedal, no stand — this is a compact single-hand children's toy, not a full-size electronic piano/keyboard instrument.
No photo shows the item powered on, lit up, or producing sound.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a 5-key children's toy with cartoon character keys, not a true electronic piano/keyboard instrument; comparable item types (e.g. Yamaha DGX) are full 61/88-key instruments, visibly different from this toy.

claims.claim: "with all blue songs and other songs preloaded"
claims.evidence: No audio, video, or screen output shown in either photo; cannot confirm any preloaded songs or that unit powers on.
No functional demonstration in photos; educational claim cannot be checked from stills.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or keys may not trigger sound (common failure point: battery compartment/contacts seen in photo 1).
risks.proof: Short video of the toy powered on with at least one key pressed producing sound.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / non-functional unit

risks.risk: Missing or corroded batteries, or missing battery cover screw affecting completeness.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of open battery compartment with batteries in place.

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear, cracks, or missing parts not visible from these two angles.
risks.proof: Additional photos from top, side, and close-up of key surfaces.
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst-case visible condition only

proof_requests: Video of the toy powered on, demonstrating at least one preloaded song playing
Close-up of battery compartment with batteries installed
Additional angle photos (top/side) showing full condition of keys and housing
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a small Bluey-branded children's toy piano, not a full electronic piano/keyboard instrument, but the only comparable supplied (a Yamaha DGX 520 full-size keyboard) is a completely different product category and cannot be used to price this toy.
